scope: Semantic annotations supplement frozen heuristic flags. They do not replace any original row or claim human application acceptance.

cases.finding: The two SampleData.cs sources are not byte-identical: both contain 431 lines and 66,929 bytes, but 143 line positions differ. Album insertion order differs, including the first album. Read outputs expose lines 1-360 of each, then persist for 40 later calls.
cases.implication: Large retained inputs support H2's observation. Filename similarity does not justify deduplication or a claim of wasted rereading; order determines relevant IDs.

cases.finding: Agent-authored test.py twice tries JSON decoding on an empty response. A diagnostic shows HTTP 405. The helper default method='GET' overrides the expected POST when data is supplied. Changing the helper to select POST for data yields TOTAL 41 FAILED 0.
cases.implication: Repeated validation and a test-helper repair are observable. They do not establish an application defect. A product context edit also occurred during diagnosis, so do not attribute every intervening call to the helper alone.

cases.finding: The frozen test_failure_text flag matches FAILED in TOTAL 41 FAILED 0. These outputs report zero failures.
cases.implication: Use the column as a literal screening flag, not a count of failed tests. Preserve the original flag and this counterexample.

cases.finding: The requests import probe reports ModuleNotFoundError while sqlite3 is available.
cases.implication: This traceback is an environment probe, not a failed product behavior requirement.
